content.title: SpaceXNow - Upcoming and Past Launches
content.text: Starlink Group 17-22By SpaceX F9 B5 - B1097.8 VSFB, SLC-4E 4/18/2026, 9:00:00 AM CDT SSO OCISLY Reused Launching in 2 days, 7 hours, 11 minutesStarlink Group 17-27By SpaceX F9 B5 - B1082.21 VSFB, SLC-4E 4/14/2026, 11:29:49 PM CDT SSO OCISLY Reused Launched 1 day, 2 hours, 18 minutes agoWelcome to SpaceXNowSpaceXNow is a fan-made website and mobile application dedicated to following all things SpaceX. Stay up to date with the latest launches, vehicle info, and detailed statistics, all in one place, so you never miss a launch. For official SpaceX news and information, visit spacex.com.The app provides access to the upcoming and past manifest, detailed launch statistics, and a range of customizable push notifications, including alerts at 24, 12, and 1 hour before launches. With features like dark mode, a patch viewer, the ability to filter missions and a dedicated vehicles tab for booster and capsule information, SpaceXNow makes it easy to follow all of SpaceX's launches.Use the buttons below to install the app on your preferred platform.
